prompt.model_desc: a Caucasian Brazilian man in his early-to-mid 30s, athletic build, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair with natural volume, full dark groomed beard with moustache, calm confident expression
prompt.garment: a true oversized boxy t-shirt in heavyweight 300gsm suedine knit, {COR}, dense matte surface with a soft peach-skin hand, wide square body, strongly dropped shoulders with the seam falling well down the upper arm, wide short sleeves reaching the elbow with a double-stitched hem, bold 2.5 cm ribbed crew neck, straight hem below the hip, fully opaque
prompt.bottom: black cargo shorts with raw frayed hems (full-body shots: chunky gray-and-white knit sneakers)
prompt.colors: PRT, BCO, CZA (cinza), BGE, MAR, RSG (rose gold) — BGE e MAR sem foto
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: heavy 300gsm knit with real weight and a dense, fully matte surface with a very soft peach-skin nap — no sheen at all. The boxy body holds its own square volume: side seams hang straight, the fabric forms only a few broad, soft folds and never clings to the chest or stomach. Wide 2.5 cm ribbed collar, firm and dense, sits flat and frames the neck; shoulder-to-shoulder reinforcement tape; dropped shoulder seam well down the upper arm; sleeves stand as wide tubes ending in a turned double-stitched hem. Movement: slow and weighty — when the arm is raised the sleeve lifts as one thick piece and the body folds in thick rounded bends instead of small wrinkles.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man; supplier has not published measurements, so proportions follow the photos): the body falls straight and wide, ending several centimeters below the hip over the shorts waistband; the chest is clearly boxy with generous ease; the shoulder seam drops about 6–8 cm down the upper arm; the sleeves reach the elbow.
